span.p:
AWS_DEPLOY_* · masked + PROTECTED
(only pipelines on protected main)

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
IAM user guestbook-ci-plan
only permission: sts:AssumeRole
on role guestbook-ci-plan

div.style: color: rgb(69, 26, 3) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
IAM user guestbook-ci-deploy
only permission: sts:AssumeRole
on role guestbook-ci-deploy

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Role guestbook-ci-plan · 1 h session
ReadOnlyAccess + state-bucket RW

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Role guestbook-ci-deploy · 1 h session
services: ec2 ecs elb rds logs cloudwatch sns events
backup kms secretsmanager cloudfront wafv2 autoscaling
condition: aws:RequestedRegion ∈ {eu-north-1, us-east-1}
s3:* only guestbook-* · ecr:* only guestbook-api
iam:* only guestbook-dev-* / guestbook-prod-*
iam:PassRole only to ecs-tasks / backup / flow-logs

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Explicit DENY iam:*
on guestbook-ci-* users, roles, policies
(no self-escalation)

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Role guestbook-dev-api-execution
(used by the ECS agent)
AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
+ GetSecretValue on ONE secret
+ kms:Decrypt on ONE key

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Role guestbook-dev-api-task
(used by the app code)
NO permissions

encrypted with KMS main key
